Game Overview

Bread Pit puts players into a clicker experience centered on guide your bread slice through quirky puzzles, dodging obstacles and collecting cheese delights on its journey. Instruct clever mice to assist your toasty mission and unravel each level's unique challenges in this delightful bread-to-toaster adventure.

How to Play

Getting started in Bread Pit doesn't take long to learn. Guide your bread slice through quirky puzzles, dodging obstacles and collecting cheese delights on its journey. Instruct clever mice to assist your toasty mission and unravel each level's unique challenges in this delightful bread-to-toaster adventure.

The goal is to guide your bread slice through quirky puzzles, dodging obstacles and collecting cheese delights on its journey. Instruct clever mice to assist your toasty mission and unravel each level's unique challenges in this delightful bread-to-toaster adventure.
